stanza: The opposite of white
Isn't black but rainbow blood
This house is too narrow
And made from endangered wood
Me and my Arrow
Straighter than narrow
Wherever we go, everyone knows
It's me and my Arrow

sparrow.line: Wrapped in the wings of a sparrow
sparrow.lineNext: Beak is as sharp as an arrow

sparrow.line: Makes me warble and rise, like a sparrow
stanza: And then the system of strings tugs on the tip of my wings
(cut from cardboard and old magazines):
Makes me warble and rise, like a sparrow
And in the place where I stood, there is a circle of wood —
A cord or two — which you chop, and you stack in your barrow
And it is terribly good to carry water and chop wood
Streaked with soot, heavy-booted and wild-eyed;
As I crash through the rafters
And the ropes and the pulleys trail after
And the holiest belfry burns sky-high

sparrow.songTitle: Yankee Bayonet (I Will Be Home Then)
sparrow.line: Look for me with the sun-bright sparrow
stanza: Solider and Girl: But O my love though our bodies may be parted
Though our skin may not touch skin
Look for me with the sun-bright sparrow
I will come on the breath of the wind
